description_en: You can call this operation to query the details of a multi-zone instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeMultiZoneCluster可以获取多可用区实例的详情信息
name: DescribeMultiZoneCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multi-zone instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to obtain the list. The multi-zone instances in the list have the **DbType** of hbaseue and the **ModuleStackVersion** of 2.0
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例的Id，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html获取列表，列表中**DbType**为hbaseue且**ModuleStackVersion**为2.0的多可用区实例
parameters.name: cluster_id
